question.text: A capacitor of capacitance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>500</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></math> is charged completely using a de supply of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math>. It is now connected to an inductor of inductance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mH</mi></math> to form an LC circuit. The maximum current in LC circuit will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Energy stored in capacitor

E=12CV2=12500×10-6×104

⇒E=52J

Current will be maximum when whole energy of capacitor becomes energy of inductor.

⇒12LI2=52

⇒I=5L=550×10-3=10 A
